units.source_text: 源氏内大臣打扮得齐齐整整，走出门去时，前驱者高声喝道。

en.t: The Genji Minister of the Interior dressed himself neatly and, as he went out the gate, the outriders called out in loud voices.

units.source_text: 头中将与兵卫督坐在车子后面奉陪。

en.t: The Captain Secretary and the Captain of the Guards rode behind the carriage in attendance.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣对他们说：“我这个简陋不堪的隐避所被你们找到了，真遗憾！”

en.t: The Genji Minister of the Interior said to them, "You have found this miserably humble hiding place of mine. What a pity!"

units.source_text: 头中将答道：“昨晚好月亮，我们不曾来奉陪，抱歉之至。

en.t: The Captain Secretary replied, "The moon was lovely last night, and we are deeply sorry that we did not come to attend you.

units.source_text: 因此今天冒着朝雾前来迎接。

en.t: So today we came through the morning mist to escort you back.

units.source_text: 山中的红叶时候还早，野间的秋花此刻正茂盛呢。

en.t: It is still too early for the mountain maples, but the autumn flowers in the fields are now at their height.

units.source_text: 昨天同来的某某朝臣，在途中放鹰猎取鸟兽，落在后面，现在不知怎么样了。”

en.t: The courtier So-and-so, who came with us yesterday, released his hawks along the way to hunt birds and animals, fell behind, and now I do not know what has become of him."
